test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Which of the following information is necessary to construct a rectangle?

options.text: Only the length of one side
Only the length of the diagonal
Length of one side and the area of the rectangle

solution:
The correct answer is __Length of two adjacent sides.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Length of two adjacent sides__ is necessary to construct a rectangle.
 
• Knowing only the length of one side or the diagonal is insufficient to construct a rectangle.
 
• The area of a rectangle along with the length of one side can help find the other side, but not the diagonal or angles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Rectangle Properties:**

 
 
• A rectangle has two pairs of equal opposite sides.
 
• All angles are 90 degrees.
 
• The diagonal divides it into two right triangles.
